exposure: Antibiotic prescription patterns based on the WHO AWaRe classification
cohort: The study examined 502 patient files of neonates in a referral neonatal intensive care unit in southwestern Iran, 483 of whom received antibiotics.
finding: The antibiotic prescription rate was high, with most neonates receiving two antibiotics for a mean of 7.78 days, predominantly from the Access group according to the WHO AWaRe classification.
